rationale.usefulness: Visible reusable graphs, typed links and core templates make creative asset work inspectable and actionable (creative-cf-workflow, Starting with a template; creative-cf-repo, Features). Setup and output review remain material costs.
rationale.impact: A substantial enabling layer for repeatable local multimodal production and application integration (creative-cf-repo, Features). Evidence supports domain-wide workflow significance, not a new model breakthrough or measured educational gains.
rationale.novelty: Meaningful graph-based composition, reusable workflow metadata and extension points distinguish the working method (creative-cf-workflow, Saving and sharing workflows). This is a baseline; the sources do not establish a newly introduced capability or unique invention.
rationale.maturity: Documented core templates, installation paths, error marking and dependency guidance support practical usability (creative-cf-workflow; creative-cf-dependencies). Official warnings about dependency conflicts and unstable development commits prevent an exceptional reliability rating; no execution was tested.
rationale.openness: Inspectable GPL-3.0 core, JSON workflows, local API and documented offline mode provide strong user control (creative-cf-repo, Resources and Features). Copyleft is not permissive licensing, and separate models, extensions and environment dependencies limit universal portability and rights.

concerns: Non-blocking: the six relevant ledger claims use short excerpts; direct official-source spot checks confirmed the pivotal template, metadata, dependency, license and offline assertions on 2026-10-18. All four sources belong to one publisher family.

No independent performance, reproducibility or learner-outcome test is implied. Current 1824-word body is within the 2000-word tier for this reviewer's impact 7; root must reconcile the final mean impact.
